title: 🔥豪赌预期与估值背离
body: 市场处于预期与估值严重背离的阶段。场外巨鲸押注反弹至80000美元，但BTC价格仅报$64,279，甚至低于200日定投成本$70,635。现价距离成本线偏离-9.0%，筹码尚未全部获利，缺乏支撑反转的共识基础。偏空。谁在接盘豪赌？
title_en: 🔥 High-Stakes Bet on Expectation vs. Valuation Divergence
body_en: The market is currently in a phase of severe disconnect between expectations and valuation. OTC whales are betting on a rebound to $80,000, but BTC is trading at just $64,279—below the 200-day DCA cost basis of $70,635. The price sits -9.0% below the cost line, and not all chips are profitable yet. There is no consensus to support a reversal. Bearish. Who is absorbing this gamble?
